title.narrative: Danish contribution to "Libya Recovery Trust Fund" (2022 - 27974)

description.narrative:
The LRTF is established to support Libya’s recovery efforts and longer term development activities by enhancing the work of the of the UN and non-UN entities called upon to implement programme activities. In particular, the LRTF will support Libya’s transition plans in the aftermath of the conflict. The LRTF operational arrangements will ensure that:
a) Each project approved for funding is part of a nationally-approved priority programme related to recovery and development initiatives, in line with the Libyan coordinated needs assessment. It is based on or formulated in consultation with line ministries and beneficiary communities. b) Funding and implementation are undertaken by with special attention to transparence and accountability. c) The Fund will enhance speed and flexibility in delivering results and efficient utilization of funds. d) It will give special focus on building the capacities of the government and other national institutions.
